mapper.sql: select s.station_id, s.station_name, s.address, s.province, s.city, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.capacity, s.user_id, s.contact, s.phone, s.image_url, s.status, s.operator_rate, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.tenant_id, coalesce(settle.total_income, 0) as total_income, coalesce(dev.online_count, 0) as online_count, coalesce(dev.offline_count, 0) as offline_count, coalesce(dev.fault_count, 0) as fault_count from dr_station s left join (select station_id, sum(station_amount) as total_income from dr_settlement where del_flag = '0' group by station_id) settle on settle.station_id = s.station_id left join (select station_id, sum(case when device_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as online_count, sum(case when device_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as offline_count, sum(case when device_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as fault_count from dr_resource where del_flag = '0' group by station_id) dev on dev.station_id = s.station_id
